# Product Enrichment Scripts

Read the cross-repository script catalog first, then the owning repository `scripts/README.md`. Prefer reuse or extension. A new repeatable script needs clear inputs, safety classification, no secrets, a confirmation guard for write/destructive behavior, and an index entry. Do not create a script for ordinary product code or a disposable one-line inspection.
